title: Lost Odyssey
shortDescription: Hironobu Sakaguchi and novelist Kiyoshi Shigematsu craft the story of immortal Kaim Argonar in a magic-industrial era.
historicalSignificance: Treasured as one of the finest traditional Japanese RPGs of the 360 generation, famous for emotional dream stories.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
